aandoen: to put on; to do (to someone)
aannemen: to accept; to assume; to hire
addertje: catch (addertje onder het gras = hidden catch)
afgezet: dropped off; turned off; ripped off
afslaan: to turn down; to turn off
bedoelt: means (wat bedoel je = what do you mean)
bellen: to call, to ring; bells, bubbles
best: best; quite, rather (best leuk = quite nice)
bevalt: pleases (het bevalt me = I like it)
der: of the (old form, as in in der tijd)
eens: once; just (kijk eens = just look); agreed (mee eens)
eitje: little egg; (een eitje = a piece of cake)
er: there; of it/them (er zijn = there are)
eraan: to it, on it (denk eraan = remember it)
ertoe: to it (het doet er niet toe = it doesn't matter)
fluitje: whistle (een fluitje van een cent = a piece of cake)
gaat: go(es) (hoe gaat het? = how are you?)
gelijk: right (gelijk hebben = be right); equal; at once
gesteld: put; asked (gesteld zijn op = be fond of)
geval: case (in elk geval = in any case)
graag: gladly, please (ik wil graag = I'd like)
handje: little hand (een handje helpen = lend a hand)
heen: to, towards (waar ga je heen = where are you going)
heet: hot; is called (ik heet = my name is)
hekel: dislike (een hekel hebben aan = to hate)
hoede: guard (op je hoede = on your guard)
hoef: need (ik hoef niet = I don't have to)
hoefde: needed to (hoefde niet = didn't have to)
hoeven: to need to (niet hoeven = not have to)
hoor: (I) hear; you know, really (softener at end of sentence)
houden: to keep, hold (houden van = to love)
hè: huh?; ... right? (tag at end of sentence)
j-e-h-e-b-t-o-n-s-i-n-d-e-s-t-e-e-k-g-e-: je hebt ons in de steek gelaten
jarig: having a birthday (ik ben jarig = it's my birthday)
kleurtje: colour (a blush, a bit of colour)
klopt: is right (dat klopt = that's right); knocks
kwalijk: wrong (neem me niet kwalijk = excuse me)
last: trouble, burden (last hebben van = be bothered by)
laten: to let; to leave; to have (something) done
meeslepen: to drag along; to carry away
mogen: to be allowed to; to like
oogje: little eye (een oogje houden = keep an eye)
opgevallen: noticed (het is me opgevallen = I noticed)
opmaken: to make up; to use up
opnemen: to pick up; to record; to include
overkomen: to happen to; to come across
raken: to hit, to touch; to get (raken = become)
rekenen: to count, to calculate (rekenen op = count on)
ruste: rest (hij ruste in vrede = rest in peace)
s: short for des (of the): 's ochtends = in the morning
scheelde: made a difference (het scheelde weinig = it was close)
slag: blow; battle (aan de slag = get to work)
sprekend: speaking; striking (sprekend lijken = look just like)
stellen: to put; to ask (een vraag stellen)
te: to (before a verb); too (te veel = too much)
tegen: against; to (tegen iemand zeggen = say to someone)
ten: at the, to the (ten minste = at least)
ter: to the, for the (ter wereld = in the world)
tweeën: two (met z'n tweeën = the two of us)
uithalen: to pull (a prank); to take out
uitkijken: to watch out; to look forward
uitstaan: to stand, bear (niet uitstaan = can't stand)
vandaan: from (waar kom je vandaan = where are you from)
verheug: look forward (ik verheug me erop = I'm looking forward to it)
verte: distance (in de verte = in the distance)
vind: (I) find; think (ik vind het leuk = I like it)
vlak: flat; right (vlak bij = right next to)
voorstellen: to introduce; to imagine (zich voorstellen); proposals
vroeger: in the past, earlier, used to
zin: sentence; sense; (zin hebben in) to feel like
zo: so; like this; in a moment
zo'n: such a; about (zo'n tien = about ten)
zoal: for instance (wat ... zoal = what sort of things)
zomaar: just like that, for no reason
zover: so far (het is zover = the time has come)
